text:
A student compares alpha emissions, beta emissions and gamma emissions.
Which statement is correct?
A
Alpha emissions are the most ionising.
B
Beta emissions are the most penetrating.
C
Beta emissions are part of the electromagnetic spectrum.
D
Gamma emissions are streams of charged particles.

options.label: A
options.text: Alpha emissions are the most ionising.

options.label: B
options.text: Beta emissions are the most penetrating.

options.label: C
options.text: Beta emissions are part of the electromagnetic spectrum.

options.label: D
options.text: Gamma emissions are streams of charged particles.

subject: Physics
